content:
iOS 27 adds a wide range of new features, covering areas such as Messages, Notes, Apple Wallet, and CarPlay. Here are my three favourite new features in iOS 27 so far.

Number 1: Siri App

Siri in iOS 27 has been completely rebuilt from the ground up for the AI era. One of the most exciting upgrades is the standalone Siri App. According to Apple's press release:

The Siri App gives you a convenient, quick centralised starting point for handling all kinds of questions — particularly suited to chatbot-style conversations that go beyond simple requests.

Given the popularity of apps like ChatGPT, Claude and Google Gemini, a standalone Siri App makes perfect sense. And since it ships pre-installed on the iPhone home screen, I expect it'll quickly become one of the most-used apps for many users.

Number 2: Suggestions in Messages

Many Apple Intelligence features in iOS 27 don't really feel like "AI" — they just offer genuinely useful tools. The suggestions for actions you can take inside the Messages app are a great example. Apple says:

Many messaging apps have tried to weave AI chatbots into conversations, and I've never been a fan of that approach.

However, the one-tap suggestions in Messages are useful in many ways, and are faster and easier than typing out an AI prompt. This is exactly the kind of AI feature I can fully get behind.

Number 3: Smart Event Details in Apple Calendar

iOS 27 brings a feature I've been waiting for in Apple Calendar: natural-language event creation. Apple calls it "Smart Event Details".

With Apple Intelligence, you can type an event in your own words and iOS 27 will automatically detect and fill in the important details, including:

  • Title
  • Time
  • Location
  • Invitees

With Smart Event Details, you no longer have to enter all this information manually. Just write everything in a single line of text, and the AI will update the event accordingly.
